\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}

\begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{axis}[
    width=8cm,height=7cm,
    xmin=0,xmax=1,ymin=0,ymax=1,zmin=0,zmax=6,
    view={120}{35},grid=major,
    xlabel=$x$,ylabel=$y$,zlabel=$z$,
    point meta min=0,point meta max=12,
    colormap={pos}{color(0cm)=(white);color(6cm)=(blue)}
  ]
    \addplot3[surf,mesh/cols=2,mark=none,point meta max=6]
      coordinates {(0,0,6) (1,0,6) (0,1,6) (1,1,6)};
  \end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
